Topic: Hands-on lab for using GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code to improve developer productivity with agent mode, natural language interactions, and DevOps/IaC workflows
Title: LAB510: The Power of GitHub Copilot in VS Code
Title_kr: LAB510: VS Code에서 GitHub Copilot의 강력한 기능
Session_Description: This hands-on lab dives deep into using GitHub Copilot within Visual Studio Code to maximize its value in daily coding tasks. Participants will learn how Copilot can transform workflows using agent mode, model selection strategies, and productivity techniques that maintain code quality. The lab also covers natural language interactions with Azure resources and databases, plus generating Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD workflows with AI assistance.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Visual Studio Code에서 GitHub Copilot을 활용하여 일상적인 코딩 작업에서 가치를 극대화하는 방법을 심층적으로 다룹니다. 참가자는 agent mode, 모델 선택 전략, 그리고 코드 품질을 유지하면서 생산성을 높이는 기법을 통해 Copilot이 워크플로를 어떻게 변화시키는지 학습합니다. 또한 자연어로 Azure 리소스 및 데이터베이스와 상호작용하는 방법과, AI 지원을 통해 Infrastructure as Code 및 CI/CD 워크플로를 생성하는 방법도 다룹니다.
Learning_Objectives: Use Copilot code completions from natural language; explore codebases with Copilot Chat using @workspace; provide project context via Copilot instructions files; use Agent mode for complex multi-file changes; interact with Azure resources using natural language; query databases using natural language with Copilot extensions; generate IaC templates (Terraform or Bicep) with AI assistance; create CI/CD workflows with Copilot; understand tool-calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities.
Technologies_Used: Visual Studio Code;GitHub Copilot;MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code;GitHub Copilot for Azure extension;Terraform;Bicep;CI/CD workflows;Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Prerequisites: At Ignite, a virtual environment with all prerequisites and required accounts is provided. To run outside of Ignite, follow the setup instructions at https://gh.io/lab510-msignite25.

Topic: Building agentic RAG knowledge bases with Azure AI Search
Title: LAB511: Build Agentic Knowledge Bases: Next-Level RAG with Azure AI Search
Title_kr: LAB511: Azure AI Search로 에이전틱 지식 베이스 구축: 차세대 RAG
Session_Description: In this hands-on lab, you’ll build a Knowledge Base using agentic RAG, the next evolution of retrieval in Azure AI Search. You will connect an agentic retrieval engine to enterprise data using smart source selection across multiple indexes and storage systems. You’ll learn to enhance planning with natural language guidance and generate grounded responses with citations or extractive answers tailored to your use case. By the end, you will have a functional Agentic Knowledge Base that responds over enterprise data.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Azure AI Search의 차세대 검색 방식인 에이전틱 RAG를 사용하여 Knowledge Base를 구축합니다. 여러 인덱스와 스토리지 시스템 전반에서 스마트 소스 선택을 활용해 에이전틱 검색 엔진을 엔터프라이즈 데이터에 연결합니다. 자연어 가이던스로 계획(Planning)을 강화하고, 사용 사례에 맞춘 인용(citation) 기반의 근거 있는 응답 또는 추출형(extractive) 답변을 생성하는 방법을 학습합니다. 세션이 끝나면 엔터프라이즈 데이터에 대해 응답하는 완전한 에이전틱 Knowledge Base를 완성하게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Design and build a Knowledge Base using agentic RAG to retrieve, reason, and respond over enterprise data; implement smart source selection to query multiple indexes and data sources; use natural language guidance to improve query planning and produce grounded, citation-rich or extractive responses.
Lab_Modules: Deploy Yourself Guide (infrastructure deployment and environment setup); Jupyter notebook exercises to build the agentic retrieval engine and Knowledge Base; smart source selection across multiple indexes and storage systems; natural language guidance for planning; response generation with citations or extractive answers.
Technologies_Used: Azure AI Search; Azure Foundry Service (Azure OpenAI) with GPT-4.1 and text-embedding-3-large; Azure Storage (Blob Storage); Python; Jupyter notebooks; Azure SDK for Python (azure-search-documents, azure-identity, azure-storage-blob); Visual Studio Code

Topic: Prototyping multimodal AI agents using Microsoft Foundry and the AI Toolkit in Visual Studio Code, including model selection, prompt/context engineering, and tool integration via MCP.
Title: LAB512: Prototyping multimodal agents with Microsoft Foundry and the AI Toolkit
Title_kr: LAB512: Microsoft Foundry 및 AI Toolkit을 사용한 멀티모달 에이전트 프로토타이핑
Session_Description: In this lab, you'll get hands-on with the AI Toolkit (AITK) and Microsoft Foundry in VS Code to explore and compare the latest multimodal and reasoning models from the Model Catalog. You will learn how to augment models for a real-world business scenario using prompt and context engineering. You will also prototype an agent using the AITK Agent Builder and equip it with the right tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습에서는 VS Code에서 AI Toolkit(AITK)과 Microsoft Foundry를 직접 사용하여 Model Catalog의 최신 멀티모달 및 추론 모델을 탐색하고 비교합니다. 프롬프트 및 컨텍스트 엔지니어링을 활용해 실제 비즈니스 시나리오에 맞게 모델을 보강하는 방법을 학습합니다. 또한 AITK Agent Builder로 에이전트를 프로토타이핑하고, MCP(Model Context Protocol)를 통해 적절한 도구를 연결하는 방법을 다룹니다.
Learning_Objectives: Explore and compare models to select the best fit for a business scenario; augment models with prompts and data to produce more accurate and grounded responses; prototype an agent by combining models and instructions with tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Learning Outcomes; Note for Self-Learners (prerequisites and setup); Technologies Used; Microsoft Learn MCP Server (installation and usage); Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: AI Toolkit for Visual Studio Code (AITK); Visual Studio Code; GitHub Models; Microsoft Foundry Models; MCP (Model Context Protocol); Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Azure; gpt-5-mini
Prerequisites: For self-learners: an Azure subscription with a provisioned Microsoft Foundry Project and a gpt-5-mini model instance (deployable via the provided ARM template link); a GitHub account.

Topic: Building A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol) multi-agent systems using Microsoft Agent Framework and SWE agents
Title: LAB513: Build A2A and MCP Systems using SWE Agents and agent-framework
Title_kr: LAB513: SWE Agents 및 agent-framework를 사용하여 A2A 및 MCP 시스템 구축
Session_Description: Learn to use Microsoft Agent Framework (a unified platform from the Semantic Kernel and AutoGen engineering teams) to build A2A-compatible agents. Use SWE Agents such as the GitHub Copilot coding agent and Codex with Azure OpenAI models to accelerate development. Implement MCP tools to enable secure enterprise agentic workflows, and get hands-on experience building, deploying, and orchestrating multi-agent systems with pre-release capabilities.
Session_Description_kr: Semantic Kernel 및 AutoGen 엔지니어링 팀이 제공하는 통합 플랫폼인 Microsoft Agent Framework를 활용하여 A2A 호환 에이전트를 구축하는 방법을 학습합니다. GitHub Copilot 코딩 에이전트와 Azure OpenAI 모델을 사용하는 Codex 등 SWE Agents를 활용해 개발을 가속화합니다. 또한 보안이 강화된 엔터프라이즈 에이전틱 워크플로를 위해 MCP 도구를 구현하고, 사전 공개 기능을 사용하여 멀티 에이전트 시스템을 직접 구축, 배포 및 오케스트레이션하는 실습을 진행합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Build A2A (Agent-to-Agent) compatible agents using Microsoft Agent Framework; Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools for secure enterprise workflows; Deploy and orchestrate multi-agent workflows
Lab_Modules: spec-to-agents repository for detailed lab instructions and hands-on exercises; Skillable-related instructions in lab/instructions; Microsoft Learn MCP Server setup via VS Code one-click install and mcp.json configuration
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Agent Framework; Semantic Kernel; AutoGen; A2A (Agent-to-Agent); MCP (Model Context Protocol); SWE Agents; GitHub Copilot coding agent; Codex; Azure OpenAI models; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Visual Studio Code

Topic: Building and deploying AI agents using MCP tools on Azure Functions with durable orchestration and vector search
Title: LAB514: Build and deploy AI agents with MCP and Azure Functions
Title_kr: LAB514: MCP 및 Azure Functions로 AI 에이전트를 빌드하고 배포하기
Session_Description: Build an intelligent code-snippet service using Azure Functions that demonstrates how to create MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools for AI assistants like GitHub Copilot. Implement durable AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework, orchestrate multi-agent workflows with Durable Functions, and enable semantic search using Azure Cosmos DB vector search with OpenAI embeddings.
Session_Description_kr: Azure Functions를 사용하여 GitHub Copilot과 같은 AI 어시스턴트를 위한 MCP(Model Context Protocol) 도구를 만드는 방법을 보여주는 지능형 코드 스니펫 서비스를 구축합니다. Microsoft Agent Framework로 내구성 있는(durable) AI 에이전트를 구현하고, Durable Functions로 멀티 에이전트 워크플로를 오케스트레이션하며, OpenAI 임베딩을 활용한 Azure Cosmos DB 벡터 검색으로 시맨틱 검색을 활성화합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Expose Azure Functions as discoverable MCP tools for AI assistants; Create stateful AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework with automatic state management; Implement vector embeddings and semantic search with Azure Cosmos DB; Orchestrate multi-agent workflows using Durable Task Scheduler; Deploy and monitor AI-powered serverless applications on Azure
Lab_Modules: MCP Tool Integration (expose Azure Functions as discoverable tools); Durable AI Agents (stateful agents with Microsoft Agent Framework); Multi-Agent Orchestration (coordinate specialized agents such as DeepWiki and CodeStyle using Durable Task Scheduler); Vector Search (semantic code retrieval using Azure Cosmos DB DiskANN with OpenAI embeddings); Monitoring & Observability (track orchestrations with DTS dashboard); Microsoft Learn MCP Server setup (VS Code install, mcp.json configuration)
Technologies_Used: Azure Functions; Durable Functions; Durable Task Scheduler (DTS); Azure Cosmos DB vector search (DiskANN); Azure OpenAI Service (embeddings); Microsoft Agent Framework; Model Context Protocol (MCP); GitHub Copilot; Visual Studio Code

Topic: Hands-on lab to build an AI-powered legal research agent using PostgreSQL on Azure with RAG, vector search, and graph-based reasoning via Microsoft Agent Framework
Title: LAB515: Build advanced AI Agents with PostgreSQL
Title_kr: LAB515: PostgreSQL로 고급 AI 에이전트를 구축하기
Session_Description: In this hands-on lab, you’ll build an AI-powered legal research assistant that reasons over real-world case law data using PostgreSQL and Microsoft Agent Framework. You’ll learn how to combine retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and graph intelligence to develop an agentic workflow capable of generating accurate, contextual, and explainable answers. The solution runs on Azure Database for PostgreSQL and uses Azure OpenAI for embeddings and completions.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 PostgreSQL과 Microsoft Agent Framework를 사용하여 실제 판례 데이터를 기반으로 추론하는 AI 기반 법률 리서치 어시스턴트를 구축합니다. retrieval-augmented generation(RAG), 벡터 검색, 그래프 인텔리전스를 결합하여 정확하고 맥락에 맞으며 설명 가능한 답변을 생성하는 에이전틱 워크플로를 구현하는 방법을 학습합니다. 솔루션은 Azure Database for PostgreSQL에서 실행되며, 임베딩과 생성(Completion)을 위해 Azure OpenAI를 사용합니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Configure Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with AI extensions (azure_ai, pgvector, diskann, apache_age) - Build autonomous agents using Microsoft Agent Framework with database and web plugins - Implement semantic search and reranking using vector embeddings - Improve reasoning with the GraphRAG pattern using graph relationships - Deploy the agent and infrastructure on Azure using Bicep and CLI automation
Lab_Modules: 1. Setup Azure PostgreSQL Database: database connection and configuration; install azure_ai extension; configure Azure OpenAI connectivity 2. Using AI-driven features in PostgreSQL: pattern matching queries; semantic vector search using embeddings; DiskANN indexing for fast vector similarity search 3. Building the Agent Application: set up Microsoft Agent Framework; create database search plugins; implement semantic reranking; add external data sources; test and improve the agent Getting Started workflow: provision resources with azd; initialize tables/indexes and load dataset; enable extensions; run Code/lab.ipynb to generate embeddings, run semantic/graph queries, and interact with the agent
Technologies_Used: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server; PostgreSQL extensions (azure_ai; pgvector; DiskANN; Apache AGE); Microsoft Agent Framework; Azure OpenAI Service; Python; Jupyter notebooks; VS Code PostgreSQL Extension; Azure Developer CLI (azd); Bicep; Azure CLI; PowerShell
Prerequisites: Azure subscription with access to Azure OpenAI; Azure Developer CLI (azd) installed and ability to run azd auth login/env new/provision; Visual Studio Code with the VS Code PostgreSQL Extension; ability to run the provided Jupyter notebook (Code/lab.ipynb)

Topic: Automated AI red teaming for generative AI agent safety and security using Microsoft Foundry
Title: LAB516: Safeguard your agents with AI Red Teaming Agent in Microsoft Foundry
Title_kr: LAB516: Microsoft Foundry의 AI Red Teaming Agent로 에이전트를 안전하게 보호하기
Session_Description: This hands-on workshop introduces the fundamentals of automated AI red teaming for generative AI systems to assess safety and security risks using Microsoft Foundry. Participants learn to apply automated attack techniques to uncover safety issues and security vulnerabilities across multiple risk dimensions before deployment. The lab includes guided walkthroughs and practical exercises to apply these methods in realistic development scenarios.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 워크숍에서는 Microsoft Foundry를 사용하여 생성형 AI 시스템의 안전 및 보안 위험을 평가하기 위한 자동화된 AI 레드팀의 기본 개념을 소개합니다. 참가자는 배포 전에 여러 위험 차원에 걸쳐 안전 문제와 보안 취약점을 찾기 위해 자동화된 공격 기법을 적용하는 방법을 학습합니다. 또한 현실적인 개발 시나리오에서 이러한 개념을 적용할 수 있도록 안내형 워크스루와 실습 과제를 수행합니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Describe what the AI Red Teaming Agent does and why it matters for AI safety - Identify and test against core risk categories with diverse attack strategies - Configure and test different target types (callbacks, models, and app endpoints) - Run AI Red Teaming Agent scans locally and in the cloud (using Azure AI SDKs) - Analyze scan results and metrics locally and in the cloud (using Microsoft Foundry Portal) - Compare baseline and advanced attack strategies for a real-world scenario
Lab_Modules: - Create a personal copy of the repo (fork) - Launch GitHub Codespaces development environment - Launch the web-based Workshop Guide (mkdocs serve) - Hands-on walkthroughs and guided exercises for automated AI red teaming - Configure and test targets (callbacks, models, app endpoints) - Run scans locally and in the cloud - Analyze results and metrics in Microsoft Foundry Portal - Compare baseline vs advanced attack strategies
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Foundry Portal;Microsoft Foundry SDK (Azure AI Projects);Azure AI Red Teaming Agent;Azure AI Evaluation SDK;Azure AI Agents;Azure OpenAI Service;PyRIT;Azure Developer CLI;GitHub Codespaces;VS Code;Python Notebooks;MkDocs;Microsoft Learn MCP Server
Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with AI application development and the AI Ops lifecycle; familiarity with GitHub Codespaces, VS Code, and Python Notebooks is recommended; a GitHub account is required; Azure subscription needed for self-guided learning (instructor-led sessions may use a pre-provisioned Skillable subscription).

Topic: AI-assisted operations for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using models, agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Title: LAB517: Next-Gen AKS Operations with Models, and Agents, and MCPs
Title_kr: LAB517: 모델, 에이전트 및 MCP를 활용한 차세대 AKS 운영
Session_Description: Build confidence in managing AKS at scale with next‑gen ops tools. In this hands‑on lab, you’ll simulate a production service hit by traffic spikes, discover how AI‑driven alerts surface hidden bottlenecks, and deploy agents that self‑heal nodes. Using open‑source tools and the aks‑mcp server, you can automate cluster scaling, patch management, and real‑time troubleshooting with natural‑language commands and pre‑built MCP integrations.
Session_Description_kr: 차세대 운영 도구를 활용하여 대규모 AKS 관리를 자신 있게 수행하는 방법을 익힙니다. 이 실습형 랩에서는 트래픽 급증으로 영향을 받는 프로덕션 서비스를 시뮬레이션하고, AI 기반 알림이 숨겨진 병목을 어떻게 드러내는지 확인하며, 노드를 자가 치유하는 에이전트를 배포합니다. 오픈 소스 도구와 aks-mcp server를 사용하여 자연어 명령과 사전 구축된 MCP 통합을 통해 클러스터 스케일링, 패치 관리, 실시간 문제 해결을 자동화할 수 있습니다.
Learning_Objectives: Deploy and configure AI agent frameworks (AKS MCP Server, CLI Agent, kagent) with Azure AI Foundry models; build multi-agent systems for operational tasks; troubleshoot production scenarios using natural language; orchestrate automated remediation for node failures, traffic spikes, and configuration drift; generate proactive health assessments using Azure Advisor and Kubernetes best practices; understand MCP and how it standardizes AI-tool integration.
Lab_Modules: Deploy Infrastructure (set up AKS cluster, Azure AI Foundry, monitoring tools); Start Lab Activities (hands-on scenarios with AI agents); Production simulation scenario (traffic spikes); AI-driven alerting and bottleneck discovery; Agent-based self-healing for nodes; Automation tasks (cluster scaling, patch management, real-time troubleshooting); Proactive health assessments (Azure Advisor + Kubernetes best practices); MCP integrations and usage
Technologies_Used: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS); Azure AI Foundry; Model Context Protocol (MCP); AKS MCP Server; CLI Agent for AKS; kagent; Azure Monitor; Azure Log Analytics; Azure Advisor; Kubernetes
Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts and Azure is helpful but not required.

Topic: Building multi-agent applications using MCP with Microsoft Agent Framework or LangGraph, integrated with Azure Cosmos DB and Azure OpenAI
Title: LAB518: Multi-Agent Apps with Microsoft Agent Framework or LangGraph
Title_kr: LAB518: Microsoft Agent Framework 또는 LangGraph를 활용한 멀티 에이전트 앱
Session_Description: Build a multi-agent application leveraging MCP (Model Context Protocol) with the Microsoft Agent Framework in C# or LangChain in Python, integrated with Azure Cosmos DB for scalable, high-performance data persistence and retrieval. You will define agents, functions, and external service integrations, and implement memory, state management, and semantic search using Azure Cosmos DB. By the end of the lab, you will have a robust AI agent system designed for real-world applications.
Session_Description_kr: Azure Cosmos DB를 통해 확장 가능하고 고성능의 데이터 영속화 및 조회를 구현하면서, C#의 Microsoft Agent Framework 또는 Python의 LangChain을 사용해 MCP(Model Context Protocol)를 활용하는 멀티 에이전트 애플리케이션을 구축합니다. 에이전트, 함수, 외부 서비스 통합을 정의하고, Azure Cosmos DB를 사용해 메모리, 상태 관리, 시맨틱 검색을 구현합니다. 실습을 마치면 실제 업무 시나리오에 적용할 수 있는 견고한 AI 에이전트 시스템을 완성하게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Understand Microsoft Agent Framework and Extensions AI fundamentals and integration with Azure OpenAI; design and build conversational agents with message processing, response handling, and context management; implement Azure Cosmos DB for agent memory, state persistence, and chat history; develop semantic search and vector indexing with Cosmos DB; configure multi-agent coordination/orchestration (routing, communication, handoff); integrate and test external MCP servers for tool interoperability.
Lab_Modules: Exercises: LangGraph (Python) Module-0 and subsequent step-by-step exercises; Agent Framework (C#) Module-0 and subsequent step-by-step exercises; Completed Files: LangGraph (Python) demo run; Agent Framework (C#) demo run.
Technologies_Used: Visual Studio Code; GitHub Copilot; Azure Cosmos DB; Azure OpenAI Service; Microsoft Agent Framework; LangGraph; C#; Python; LangChain; MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Prerequisites: During Ignite, the lab runs in a preconfigured virtual environment with required prerequisites and accounts. Outside Ignite, follow the exercises step by step or use the provided completed files to run the multi-agent retail banking application.

Topic: Governing AI apps and agent architectures using AI Gateway capabilities in Azure API Management, including safety, compliance, monitoring, and performance optimization
Title: LAB519: Governing AI Apps & Agents with AI Gateway in Azure API Management
Title_kr: LAB519: Azure API Management의 AI Gateway로 AI 앱 및 에이전트를 거버넌스하기
Session_Description: In this hands-on lab, you will learn how to govern AI apps and agents using AI Gateway in Azure API Management. You will onboard AI models, monitor and control token usage, and enforce safety and compliance policies while improving performance with semantic caching. The lab also covers governing MCP-based agent architectures by creating secure, efficient servers from APIs or connecting to backend MCP servers to deliver responsible AI solutions at scale.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Azure API Management의 AI Gateway를 사용하여 AI 앱과 에이전트를 거버넌스하는 방법을 학습합니다. AI 모델을 온보딩하고 토큰 사용량을 모니터링 및 제어하며, 안전 및 컴플라이언스 정책을 적용하는 동시에 semantic caching으로 성능을 향상시키는 방법을 다룹니다. 또한 API로부터 안전하고 효율적인 서버를 생성하거나 백엔드 MCP 서버에 연결하여 MCP 기반 에이전트 아키텍처를 거버넌스하고, 대규모로 책임감 있고 복원력 있는 AI 솔루션을 제공할 수 있도록 합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Apply AI governance best practices using AI Gateway in Azure API Management; onboard AI models; monitor and control token usage; enforce safety and compliance controls; improve performance with semantic caching; govern MCP-based agent architectures by creating secure servers from APIs or connecting to backend MCP servers.
Lab_Modules: Onboarding AI models; Monitoring and controlling token usage; Enforcing safety and compliance; Performance optimization with semantic caching; Governing MCP-based agent architectures (create servers from APIs or connect to backend MCP servers); Using the Microsoft Learn MCP Server (VS Code install, mcp.json configuration).
Technologies_Used: Azure API Management (AI Gateway); Azure API Center (MCP Registry); Microsoft Foundry (model serving and Agent Service); Model Context Protocol (MCP); Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Visual Studio Code

Topic: Building a domain-specific AI agent for pizza ordering using Microsoft Foundry Agent Service with RAG, tool calling, and MCP integrations
Title: LAB571: Build a Pizza Ordering Agent with Microsoft Foundry and MCP
Title_kr: LAB571: Microsoft Foundry 및 MCP로 피자 주문 에이전트 구축
Session_Description: In this hands-on workshop, you’ll learn to build domain-specific AI agents with Foundry Agent Service. Starting from a simple agent, you’ll add system prompts, custom instructions, and knowledge with RAG. You’ll extend it with tool calling (like a pizza calculator) and connect external services via MCP for live menu and order handling. By the end, you’ll have a working Contoso PizzaBot that can answer questions, recommend pizzas, and manage orders.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 워크숍에서는 Foundry Agent Service를 사용하여 도메인 특화 AI 에이전트를 구축하는 방법을 학습합니다. 간단한 에이전트에서 시작하여 시스템 프롬프트, 사용자 지정 지침, RAG를 통한 지식 추가를 단계적으로 적용합니다. 또한 피자 계산기와 같은 도구 호출을 추가하고, MCP를 통해 외부 서비스와 연결하여 실시간 메뉴 및 주문 처리를 구현합니다. 세션이 끝나면 질문에 답변하고 피자를 추천하며 주문을 관리할 수 있는 Contoso PizzaBot을 완성하게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Get hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry; Build intelligent agents step by step; Understand practical use cases for system prompts, RAG, tool calling, and MCP
Lab_Modules: Build a simple agent; Add system prompts and custom instructions; Add knowledge using RAG; Implement tool calling (pizza calculator); Connect external services via MCP for live menu and order handling; Finalize Contoso PizzaBot (Q&A, recommendations, order management)
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Foundry; Foundry Agent Service; MCP; RAG; Visual Studio Code; Python

Topic: Working with multimodal healthcare AI models from setup to deployment, agentic integration, and evaluation
Title: LAB596: Working with healthcare AI models: from set-up to use-case
Title_kr: LAB596: 헬스케어 AI 모델 활용: 설정부터 사용 사례까지
Session_Description: Take a motivational tour through the healthcare AI sample repository and set yourself up for success with multimodal AI for Health & Life Sciences. Dive into notebooks and sample solutions for problems like image search, cancer grading based on radiology and pathology images, outlier detection, and exam parameter classification. Deploy a model, plug it into an agentic flow, and evaluate it with human feedback. A hands-on journey from setup to deployment and refinement.
Session_Description_kr: 헬스케어 AI 샘플 리포지토리를 살펴보며 Health & Life Sciences를 위한 멀티모달 AI를 성공적으로 활용할 수 있도록 준비합니다. 이미지 검색, 방사선/병리 이미지 기반 암 등급 분류, 이상치 탐지, 검사 파라미터 분류와 같은 문제를 다루는 노트북과 샘플 솔루션을 탐색합니다. 모델을 배포하고 이를 agentic flow에 연결한 뒤, 사람의 피드백을 통해 평가합니다. 설정부터 배포 및 개선까지를 직접 수행하는 실습 중심 여정입니다.
Learning_Objectives: Deploy and evaluate a multimodal healthcare AI model; explore healthcare foundation model use-cases; understand best practices for operational AI in healthcare.
Lab_Modules: Motivational tour of the healthcare AI sample repository; Notebooks and sample solutions (image search, cancer grading from radiology/pathology images, outlier detection, exam parameter classification); Model deployment; Integrate the model into an agentic flow; Evaluation with human feedback; Refinement.
Technologies_Used: AzureML; Healthcare AI Models; Python; Python Tools

Topic: Agentic AI in healthcare using multi-agent orchestration integrated into Microsoft 365
Title: LAB598: Agentic AI in Healthcare: Multi-Agent Orchestration in Action
Title_kr: LAB598: 헬스케어에서의 Agentic AI: 멀티 에이전트 오케스트레이션 실전 적용
Session_Description: Explore the power of agentic frameworks to streamline healthcare operations. Using Healthcare Agent Orchestrator, you can customize intelligent agents, integrate them with private datasets and public sources, and deploy them into Microsoft 365 tools like Teams and Word. Learn how healthcare-specific agents can be enhanced with general reasoning models and multimodal healthcare foundation models to handle sophisticated clinical tasks with precision and efficiency.
Session_Description_kr: Agentic framework의 역량을 활용하여 헬스케어 운영을 효율화하는 방법을 살펴봅니다. Healthcare Agent Orchestrator를 통해 지능형 에이전트를 맞춤 구성하고, 비공개 데이터셋과 공개 소스를 통합한 뒤, Teams 및 Word와 같은 Microsoft 365 도구에 원활하게 배포할 수 있습니다. 또한 일반 추론 모델과 멀티모달 헬스케어 파운데이션 모델로 강화된 헬스케어 특화 에이전트가 정밀성과 효율성을 바탕으로 고도화된 임상 업무를 처리하는 방식을 학습합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Deploy Healthcare Agent Orchestrator in Microsoft Teams; update an existing agent in Healthcare Agent Orchestrator; add a new agent to Healthcare Agent Orchestrator.
Lab_Modules: Deploy Healthcare Agent Orchestrator in MS Teams; Update existing agent in Healthcare Agent Orchestrator; Add new agent to Healthcare Agent Orchestrator.
Technologies_Used: Semantic Kernel; Bot Framework SDK (Python); AI Foundry; Microsoft Teams; Microsoft 365

Topic: Observability, governance, and scaling of agentic AI applications on Azure using Azure AI Foundry
Title: Learn how to observe, manage, and scale agentic AI apps using Azure
Title_kr: Azure를 사용하여 에이전틱 AI 앱을 관찰, 관리 및 확장하는 방법 알아보기
Session_Description: This hands-on workshop teaches participants how to manage, govern, and scale agentic AI applications using Azure and Azure AI Foundry. It covers observability capabilities, model management policies, agent functionalities, and governance strategies. Participants complete practical exercises to apply these concepts in real-world scenarios.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 워크숍은 Azure 및 Azure AI Foundry를 사용하여 에이전틱 AI 애플리케이션을 효과적으로 관리, 거버넌스 적용 및 확장하는 역량을 제공합니다. 관찰 가능성(Observability) 기능, 모델 관리 정책, 에이전트 기능, 거버넌스 전략을 다룹니다. 참가자는 실무 시나리오 기반의 실습을 통해 이러한 개념을 실제 환경에 적용합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Build and deploy an agentic AI retail chatbot on Azure AI Foundry; evaluate quality, safety, and agentic efficacy; fine-tune the model to customize tone and style; distill behavior to a smaller model for cost-effective operation; trace and monitor operations to detect and debug performance issues; understand end-to-end observability in Azure AI Foundry.
Lab_Modules: Application scenario: Zava retail shopping assistant (Cora); Build and deploy an agentic AI retail chatbot; Evaluate quality, safety, and agentic efficacy; Fine-tune model for custom tone & style; Distill to a smaller model for cost-effective operation; Trace and monitor with end-to-end observability to detect/debug issues.
Technologies_Used: Azure AI Foundry; Azure AI Agent Service; Azure AI Search; Azure AI Evaluation SDK; Azure Application Insights; Microsoft Agent Framework; OpenTelemetry

Topic: Modernizing containerized applications with AI on Azure using Azure Container Apps, Azure OpenAI, and GPU-enabled inferencing
Title: AI-Ready Apps: Containerize and Modernize with Azure
Title_kr: AI-Ready Apps: Azure로 컨테이너화 및 현대화
Session_Description: This hands-on lab shows how to modernize containerized applications with AI on Azure by deploying AI-powered apps to Azure Container Apps. Participants will integrate Azure OpenAI and run open-source models (via Ollama) on serverless GPUs for cost-efficient inferencing. The lab also covers executing untrusted code safely using dynamic sessions, building AI agents with MCP and Goose, and applying enterprise security and compliance practices.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습 랩에서는 Azure Container Apps에 AI 기반 애플리케이션을 배포하여 Azure에서 컨테이너화된 애플리케이션을 AI와 함께 현대화하는 방법을 다룹니다. 참가자는 Azure OpenAI를 통합하고 서버리스 GPU에서 오픈 소스 모델(Ollama)을 실행하여 비용 효율적인 추론을 구현합니다. 또한 Dynamic Sessions를 활용한 비신뢰 코드의 안전한 실행, MCP 및 Goose를 활용한 AI 에이전트 구축, 엔터프라이즈 보안 및 컴플라이언스 적용을 학습합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Deploy containerized AI applications to Azure Container Apps with GPU support; integrate Azure OpenAI (GPT models) using LangChain; run open-source LLMs with Ollama on GPU-enabled containers; configure dynamic sessions/session pools to execute untrusted Python code safely; build AI agents using MCP and Goose; optimize cost-efficient AI inferencing with GPU-based compute; apply enterprise security and compliance practices; use modern development practices including containerization and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Lab_Modules: AI & GPU Playbook; Environment Setup; Azure OpenAI Deployment; Ollama & Open-Source Models; Dynamic Sessions; MCP Shell Integration; Goose AI Agent; LangChain Integration; Testing & Deployment
Technologies_Used: Azure Container Apps; Azure Container Apps Dynamic Sessions; Azure OpenAI Service; GPT-3.5; GPT-4; Ollama; open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Phi); serverless GPUs/GPU acceleration; LangChain; MCP (Model Context Protocol); Goose AI Agent; Python; FastAPI; Docker; Azure CLI; MkDocs
Prerequisites: Azure subscription with appropriate permissions; Azure CLI installed and configured; WSL2 or Linux environment; Python 3.12+; VS Code or preferred IDE

Topic: Implementing persistent semantic memory for multi-agent applications using an MCP Server with Azure Cosmos DB
Title: PREL16: Preday: Implement Semantic Memories for Multi-Agent Apps in Microsoft Foundry with an MCP Server for Azure Cosmos DB
Title_kr: PREL16: 사전 워크숍: Azure Cosmos DB용 MCP Server를 사용하여 Microsoft Foundry에서 멀티 에이전트 앱을 위한 시맨틱 메모리 구현
Session_Description: This hands-on workshop teaches you how to build intelligent multi-agent applications with persistent semantic memory using an MCP Server on Azure Cosmos DB. You will explore patterns for embedding and retrieving context across threads, and implement durable memory, semantic search, and agent collaboration using LangGraph (Python) and Azure AI Foundry. Participants will leave with a scalable system design that can learn and adapt over time.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 워크숍에서는 Azure Cosmos DB에서 MCP Server를 사용하여 지속적인 시맨틱 메모리를 갖춘 지능형 멀티 에이전트 애플리케이션을 구축하는 방법을 학습합니다. 스레드 전반에서 컨텍스트를 임베딩하고 검색하는 패턴을 살펴보고, LangGraph(Python)와 Azure AI Foundry를 사용해 내구성 있는 메모리, 시맨틱 검색, 에이전트 협업을 구현합니다. 참가자는 시간이 지남에 따라 학습하고 적응할 수 있는 확장 가능한 시스템 설계를 갖추게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Design and implement multi-agent architectures in LangGraph; enable agent-to-agent handoffs and state management; build production-ready persistent agentic memory in Azure Cosmos DB (declarative/procedural/episodic) with salience and TTL; implement LLM-based preference extraction and conflict resolution; configure vector search and hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25); add automatic conversation summarization and memory consolidation; integrate observability with LangSmith tracing; design MCP server tool distribution and external API integration patterns; apply production patterns for error handling, session/state persistence, and cost-aware agentic AI best practices.
Lab_Modules: Exercises: LangGraph (Python) step-by-step workshop (01_exercises/workshop/Home.md); Completed Files: LangGraph (Python) demo application (travel multi-agent workshop README)
Technologies_Used: Azure Cosmos DB (Vector Search, Full Text Search, Hybrid Search, Agentic Memory); Azure OpenAI Service; Azure AI Foundry; LangGraph (Python); LangSmith; Model Control Protocol (MCP) Server
Prerequisites: During Ignite, a virtual environment is provided with all prerequisites and accounts. Outside Ignite, follow the exercises step by step or use the provided completed files to run the multi-agent travel assistant application.

Topic: Securely deploying and managing AI applications across hybrid environments for IT professionals
Title: PREL19: An IT Pro's guide to Deploying and managing AI applications
Title_kr: PREL19: IT 전문가를 위한 AI 애플리케이션 배포 및 관리 가이드
Session_Description: Learn how to securely deploy and manage AI apps across hybrid environments. This workshop walks through identity, networking, key vaults, monitoring, and AI-specific controls like prompt shields and data labeling. It is designed for IT pros modernizing infrastructure and explains how each layer contributes to a secure, reliable AI solution ready for real-world workloads.
Session_Description_kr: 하이브리드 환경 전반에서 AI 앱을 안전하게 배포하고 관리하는 방법을 학습합니다. 이 워크숍에서는 ID, 네트워킹, Key Vault, 모니터링과 함께 프롬프트 실드 및 데이터 라벨링과 같은 AI 특화 제어를 다룹니다. 인프라를 현대화하는 IT 전문가를 대상으로, 각 계층이 실제 워크로드에 대비한 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 솔루션에 어떻게 기여하는지 설명합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Securely deploy and manage AI applications in hybrid environments; apply identity and networking controls; use key vaults for secrets management; implement monitoring for AI workloads; understand and apply AI-specific controls such as prompt shields and data labeling.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Learn MCP Server; GitHub Copilot; VS Code

Topic: Using Azure Copilot and AI-driven operations to improve observability and optimize cost and carbon footprint in Azure
Title: LAB500: Drive observability & optimization with Azure Copilot
Title_kr: LAB500: Azure Copilot으로 관측 가능성과 최적화를 추진하기
Session_Description: Discover how AI is transforming cloud operations in Azure. In this lab, you'll use AI to investigate anomalies, correlate telemetry, and strengthen your monitoring posture. Using Copilot's new agentic optimization capabilities, you'll identify and validate cost and carbon savings opportunities while advancing FinOps and sustainability practices. These capabilities help align workload health, streamline operations, and deliver lasting efficiency and sustainability.
Session_Description_kr: AI가 Azure에서 클라우드 운영을 어떻게 변화시키는지 살펴봅니다. 이 랩에서는 AI를 사용하여 이상 징후를 조사하고, 텔레메트리를 상관 분석하며, 모니터링 태세를 강화합니다. Copilot의 새로운 agentic 최적화 기능을 활용해 비용 및 탄소 절감 기회를 식별하고 검증하면서 FinOps와 지속 가능성 실천을 발전시킵니다. 이러한 기능을 통해 워크로드 상태를 정렬하고 운영을 간소화하여 지속적인 효율성과 지속 가능성을 달성할 수 있습니다.
Learning_Objectives: Detect and troubleshoot critical application failures using unified observability; improve monitoring posture with Service Groups; understand optimization posture via cost, carbon footprint, and optimization recommendations; analyze carbon footprint drivers across cloud resources; optimize cost and carbon footprint using Azure Copilot agentic optimization capabilities.
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Learning Outcomes; Technology Used; Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Copilot; Azure Copilot; Operations Center (OpsCenter) Optimization blade; Optimization Agent; unified observability; telemetry; Service Groups

Topic: Modernizing and migrating a legacy Spring Boot application to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Automatic using GitHub Copilot and passwordless authentication patterns
Title: LAB502: Migrate to AKS Automatic with GitHub Copilot for App Modernization
Title_kr: LAB502: GitHub Copilot을 활용한 앱 현대화를 통해 AKS Automatic으로 마이그레이션
Session_Description: Learn how to modernize and migrate a legacy Spring Boot application to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Automatic using AI-powered tools. This hands-on lab walks through the journey from local development to cloud deployment, using GitHub Copilot for app modernization to assess code, implement secure authentication patterns, and automate containerization. Participants migrate from password-based authentication to Entra ID with workload identity and deploy to AKS Automatic with built-in security and operational best practices.
Session_Description_kr: AI 기반 도구를 사용하여 레거시 Spring Boot 애플리케이션을 Azure Kubernetes Service(AKS) Automatic으로 현대화하고 마이그레이션하는 방법을 학습합니다. 이 실습 랩에서는 로컬 개발부터 클라우드 배포까지의 전체 과정을 다루며, GitHub Copilot for app modernization을 활용해 코드를 평가하고 안전한 인증 패턴을 구현하며 컨테이너화를 자동화합니다. 참가자는 비밀번호 기반 인증에서 Entra ID와 workload identity를 사용하는 방식으로 전환하고, 기본 제공 보안 및 운영 모범 사례가 적용된 AKS Automatic에 배포합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Assess Spring Boot applications for cloud readiness with GitHub Copilot app modernization; migrate from self-hosted PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with Entra ID authentication; implement passwordless authentication using Azure Workload Identity and Azure Service Connector; generate Docker and Kubernetes manifests using AI-powered containerization tools; deploy to AKS Automatic with security and monitoring best practices.
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Learning Outcomes; Technologies Used; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Automatic; GitHub Copilot App Modernization; Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server; Microsoft Entra ID; Azure Workload Identity; Azure Service Connector; Containerization Assist MCP Server; Spring Boot PetClinic; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Docker; Kubernetes

Topic: End-to-end hands-on lab for deploying, migrating, and modernizing workloads with Azure VMware Solution (AVS)
Title: LAB503: AVS from Migration and Optimization to Modernization
Title_kr: LAB503: 마이그레이션 및 최적화에서 현대화까지의 AVS
Session_Description: Participants complete an end-to-end, real-world hands-on lab for Azure VMware Solution (AVS) deployment and modernization using click-through AVS labs. The lab spans six modules covering the journey from discovery and deployment to migration, connectivity, storage expansion, and modernization. The first three modules are mandatory, with additional optional modules for advanced scenarios.
Session_Description_kr: 참가자는 클릭스루 방식의 AVS 랩을 활용하여 Azure VMware Solution(AVS) 배포 및 현대화 워크플로를 엔드투엔드로 수행하는 실습형 랩에 참여합니다. 이 랩은 디스커버리와 배포부터 마이그레이션, 연결, 스토리지 확장, 현대화까지의 여정을 다루는 6개 모듈로 구성됩니다. 처음 3개 모듈은 필수이며, 이후 모듈은 고급 시나리오를 위한 선택 과정입니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Deploy and configure an AVS private cloud and manage the VMware vSphere environment via Azure Portal - Migrate VMs from on-premises to AVS using VMware HCX - Modernize applications on AVS by moving SQL to Azure SQL Managed Instance - Establish secure connectivity and controlled internet access (e.g., ExpressRoute/VPN, Azure Virtual WAN; optional module mentions Azure Route Server and Azure Firewall) - Expand AVS storage using Azure NetApp Files or Azure Elastic SAN - Onboard AVS and migrated VMs to Azure Arc for monitoring, policy, and governance
Lab_Modules: Core (mandatory): 1) Deploy AVS private cloud and manage VMware vSphere via Azure Portal 2) VM migration using VMware HCX (on-prem to AVS) 3) Modernize by moving SQL to Azure SQL Managed Instance Optional: 1) Private connectivity & internet access (Azure Route Server, Azure Firewall) 2) Expand AVS storage with Azure NetApp Files or Elastic SAN 3) Azure Arc management of AVS & VMs (onboard private cloud and migrated VMs)
Technologies_Used: Azure VMware Solution (AVS);VMware vSphere;VMware HCX (VCF Operations HCX 9.0);Azure SQL Managed Instance;Azure Arc;Azure Route Server;Azure Firewall;Azure NetApp Files;Azure Elastic SAN;ExpressRoute;VPN;Azure Virtual WAN;Azure Portal

Topic: Using Azure Arc to connect, secure, govern, and manage hybrid, multicloud, and edge environments
Title: LAB504: Connect, secure and manage hybrid, multicloud and edge with Azure Arc
Title_kr: LAB504: Azure Arc로 하이브리드, 멀티클라우드 및 엣지를 연결하고 보안 강화 및 관리하기
Session_Description: Hybrid and multicloud environments introduce complexity in connectivity, governance, and security. This hands-on lab shows how Azure Arc simplifies management across diverse infrastructures. You’ll gain practical experience onboarding resources, enabling monitoring, enforcing compliance, and strengthening security—whether workloads run on-premises, in other clouds, or at the edge.
Session_Description_kr: 하이브리드 및 멀티클라우드 환경은 연결, 거버넌스, 보안 측면에서 복잡성을 증가시킵니다. 이 실습형 랩에서는 Azure Arc가 다양한 인프라 전반의 관리를 어떻게 단순화하는지 보여줍니다. 온프레미스, 다른 클라우드 또는 엣지에서 실행되는 워크로드를 대상으로 리소스 온보딩, 모니터링 활성화, 규정 준수 적용, 보안 강화에 대한 실무 경험을 얻습니다.
Learning_Objectives: Onboard Windows virtual machines to Azure Arc and verify connectivity; configure monitoring for Arc-enabled servers using Azure Monitor Agent and VM Insights; apply governance and compliance controls with Machine Configuration policies; strengthen security posture using Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations; enable auto-upgrade for the Azure Arc agent.
Lab_Modules: Onboard Windows virtual machines to Azure Arc and verify connectivity; Configure monitoring for Arc-enabled servers using Azure Monitor Agent and VM Insights; Apply governance and compliance controls with Machine Configuration policies; Strengthen security posture by leveraging Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations; Enable auto-upgrade for the Azure Arc agent
Technologies_Used: Azure Arc; Azure Monitor Agent; VM Insights; Azure Policy Machine Configuration; Microsoft Defender for Cloud; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; VS Code

Topic: Migrating and modernizing a Linux application stack with PostgreSQL on Azure using Azure Migrate and infrastructure as code
Title: LAB505: Fast track your Linux and PostgreSQL migration with Azure Migrate
Title_kr: LAB505: Azure Migrate로 Linux 및 PostgreSQL 마이그레이션을 빠르게 진행하기
Session_Description: Learn how to seamlessly modernize a Linux application stack in Azure. Participants will step through the migration process using a Linux/Postgres/Java application and use infrastructure as code (IaC) to scale migrations.
Session_Description_kr: Azure에서 Linux 애플리케이션 스택을 원활하게 현대화하는 방법을 학습합니다. 참가자는 Linux/Postgres/Java 애플리케이션을 사용하여 마이그레이션 프로세스를 단계별로 진행하고, 대규모 마이그레이션을 위해 infrastructure as code(IaC)를 활용합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Step through the end-to-end migration process for a Linux/Postgres/Java application to Azure; Modernize a Linux application stack on Azure; Use infrastructure as code (IaC) to scale migration efforts
Technologies_Used: Azure;Azure Migrate;Linux;PostgreSQL;Java;Infrastructure as Code (IaC);Microsoft Learn MCP Server;GitHub Copilot;VS Code

Topic: Migration and modernization of Windows Server, SQL Server, and .NET workloads to Azure
Title: LAB506: Migrate and Modernize Windows and SQL Server Workloads to Azure
Title_kr: LAB506: Windows 및 SQL Server 워크로드를 Azure로 마이그레이션 및 현대화
Session_Description: This lab focuses on migrating and modernizing Windows Server, SQL Server, and .NET applications to Azure. Participants learn how to assess and migrate workloads using Azure Migrate and Azure Database Migration Service (DMS). It covers discovery, dependency mapping, migration execution, and post-migration optimization, and includes securing workloads after migration with Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Session_Description_kr: 이 랩은 Windows Server, SQL Server 및 .NET 애플리케이션을 Azure로 마이그레이션하고 현대화하는 방법에 중점을 둡니다. 참가자는 Azure Migrate와 Azure Database Migration Service(DMS)를 사용하여 워크로드를 평가하고 마이그레이션하는 방법을 학습합니다. 또한 디스커버리, 종속성 매핑, 마이그레이션 실행, 마이그레이션 후 최적화를 다루며, Microsoft Defender for Cloud를 활용한 마이그레이션 이후 워크로드 보안 강화도 포함합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Assess Windows Server and SQL Server workloads for migration; perform discovery and dependency mapping; execute migrations using Azure Migrate and Azure Database Migration Service (DMS); optimize workloads after migration; secure migrated workloads using Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Lab_Modules: Discovery;Dependency mapping;Migration execution;Post-migration optimization;Post-migration security with Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Technologies_Used: Azure;Windows Server;SQL Server;.NET;Azure Migrate;Azure Database Migration Service (DMS);Microsoft Defender for Cloud

Topic: Resiliency for mission critical applications and infrastructure using Azure Operations Center and related resiliency, backup, and configuration capabilities.
Title: LAB520: Start, Get, and Stay Resilient for your mission critical applications and infrastructure in Azure's operations platform.
Title_kr: LAB520: Azure 운영 플랫폼에서 미션 크리티컬 애플리케이션 및 인프라를 위한 복원력 시작, 강화, 지속하기
Session_Description: This lab walks through the “Start, Get, and Stay Resilient” journey for architecting mission critical applications using Azure’s resiliency and configuration experiences. Participants assess resiliency posture, apply recommendations, validate improvements, and orchestrate recovery. It also introduces the Operations Center Essentials Machine Management bundle to manage resource state, enforce configurations across devices, and maintain ongoing resilience.
Session_Description_kr: 이 랩은 Azure의 복원력 및 구성(Configuration) 경험을 활용하여 미션 크리티컬 애플리케이션을 설계하기 위한 “Start, Get, and Stay Resilient” 여정을 다룹니다. 참가자는 복원력 상태를 평가하고 권장 사항을 적용하여 개선 사항을 검증하며 복구를 오케스트레이션합니다. 또한 Operations Center의 Essentials Machine Management 번들을 통해 리소스 상태를 관리하고 디바이스 전반에 구성을 강제하여 복원력을 일회성 목표가 아닌 지속적인 상태로 유지하는 방법을 학습합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Create application-aware service groups and assign resiliency goals aligned to business objectives; evaluate and improve resiliency posture by deploying recommendations and addressing architectural drift using Copilot; apply baseline configuration recommendations and enforce policies to keep infrastructure in the expected, compliant state.
Lab_Modules: Exercise 0: Onboarding to Operations Center Essentials Machine Management; Exercise 1: Data Resiliency - Resource-Level Protection (Task 1: Create a Backup Policy; Task 2: Create Vaulted Backup for Blob); Exercise 2: Infra Resiliency (Task 1: Create a Service Group for ClaimsApp; Task 2: Assign Resiliency Goals & Review Posture; Task 3: Action on Resiliency Recommendations to Make ClaimsApp Zonally Resilient; Run the Script in Azure PowerShell)
Technologies_Used: Azure Operations Center; Azure Resiliency; Azure Backup; Azure Policy; Azure Machine Configuration; Azure Update Manager; Change Tracking and Inventory; Azure Monitor (Monitoring workspace); Log Analytics workspace; Azure Cloud Shell; Azure PowerShell; Azure Advisor; Copilot; Azure Storage (Azure Blobs); Azure Virtual Machines; Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server; Application Gateway; Load Balancer; Managed Identity
Prerequisites: Access to the provided lab environment and Azure credentials (available in the lab Resources tab); ability to use the Azure portal and navigate Operations Center; ability to run scripts using Azure Cloud Shell (PowerShell) with the provided subscription.

Topic: Geospatial intelligence with satellite and aerial imagery using Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro and Azure Databricks
Title: LAB597: Make More Informed Decisions with Geospatial Intelligence
Title_kr: LAB597: 지리공간 인텔리전스로 더 정보에 기반한 의사결정하기
Session_Description: This hands-on lab teaches participants how to leverage geospatial intelligence using Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro. Learners work with real-world data to analyze Phoenix school campuses by measuring land-surface temperature and vegetation coverage using satellite imagery and aerial photography. The lab demonstrates how enterprise geospatial data and analysis can support informed decision-making across industries.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro를 사용하여 지리공간 인텔리전스를 활용하는 방법을 학습합니다. 참가자는 실제 데이터를 기반으로 위성 영상과 항공 사진을 활용해 피닉스 지역 학교 캠퍼스를 분석하고, 지표면 온도와 식생 피복을 측정합니다. 또한 엔터프라이즈 지리공간 데이터와 분석이 다양한 산업에서 더 정보에 기반한 의사결정을 어떻게 지원하는지 확인합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Work with enterprise geospatial datasets through Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro; analyze satellite and aerial imagery to extract insights; compute vegetation indices (NDVI) and land-surface temperature from remote sensing data; scale geospatial analysis workflows using Azure Databricks; apply geospatial intelligence principles to real-world decision-making scenarios.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro; Azure Databricks; NAIP (National Agriculture Imagery Program) aerial imagery; Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 thermal imagery; Python; GeoPandas; Rasterio; Xarray
Prerequisites: No prerequisites required. At Ignite, a virtual environment with all prerequisites and required accounts is provided; to run outside Ignite, follow the setup instructions in ./lab/README.md.

Topic: Modernizing an IT estate through portfolio transformation using migration and modernization strategies with Azure and GitHub Copilot
Title: PREL20: Modernize IT Estate: From Strategy to Execution - A Hands-On Workshop for Portfolio Transformation
Title_kr: PREL20: IT 자산 현대화: 전략에서 실행까지 - 포트폴리오 전환을 위한 실습 워크숍
Session_Description: This hands-on workshop for IT leaders and practitioners focuses on modernizing the IT estate from strategy to execution. Participants learn and apply the six key migration and modernization strategies—Retire, Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Rearchitect, and Rebuild—through practical exercises and real-world case studies. The session demonstrates how to leverage Azure and GitHub Copilot for rapid, secure, and cost-effective modernization, enabling migration at scale, cost optimization, and alignment with business goals. Attendees leave with actionable methodologies and AI-powered tooling insights to accelerate cloud adoption and improve agility.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습 워크숍은 IT 리더와 실무자를 대상으로, 전략 수립부터 실행까지 IT 자산을 현대화하는 방법에 초점을 맞춥니다. 참가자는 실습과 실제 사례 연구를 통해 6가지 핵심 마이그레이션 및 현대화 전략(Retire, Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Rearchitect, Rebuild)을 학습하고 적용합니다. 또한 Azure와 GitHub Copilot을 활용해 빠르고 안전하며 비용 효율적으로 현대화를 수행하는 방법을 시연하며, 대규모 마이그레이션의 효율화, 비용 최적화, 비즈니스 목표와의 정렬을 지원합니다. 참가자는 클라우드 도입을 가속하고 민첩성을 향상시키기 위한 실행 가능한 방법론과 AI 기반 도구 활용 인사이트를 얻습니다.
Learning_Objectives: Understand and apply the six migration/modernization strategies (Retire, Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Rearchitect, Rebuild); gain hands-on experience planning and executing cloud migration using Azure and GitHub Copilot; learn approaches to cost optimization, security improvement, and modernization acceleration with AI-powered tools; build a business case for modernization including ROI and operational benefits; review real-world success stories to inform future-ready IT strategy.
Lab_Modules: Six migration and modernization strategies (Retire; Rehost; Replatform; Refactor; Rearchitect; Rebuild); practical exercises; real-world case studies; cloud migration planning and execution using Azure and GitHub Copilot; cost optimization and security considerations; business case/ROI development; success stories review
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Azure; Azure Migrate; GitHub Copilot; Visual Studio; Visual Studio Code

Topic: Hands-on workshop on building AI applications using Azure SQL Database and generative AI concepts
Title: LAB530: Build new AI Applications with Azure SQL Databases
Title_kr: LAB530: Azure SQL Database로 새로운 AI 애플리케이션 구축
Session_Description: This hands-on workshop showcases the latest Azure SQL innovations to help supercharge application development. Participants learn how to use generative AI with Azure SQL Database, including language models, prompt engineering, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). The session also covers streamlining workflows with Microsoft Copilot for developers, architects, and IT professionals building data-driven solutions.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 워크숍에서는 애플리케이션 개발을 가속화하는 최신 Azure SQL 혁신을 소개합니다. 참가자는 Azure SQL Database와 함께 generative AI를 활용하는 방법을 학습하며, language model, prompt engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation(RAG)과 같은 AI 개념을 다룹니다. 또한 개발자, 아키텍트, IT 전문가가 데이터 중심 솔루션을 구축할 때 Microsoft Copilot으로 워크플로를 간소화하는 방법도 살펴봅니다.
Learning_Objectives: Understand how to combine generative AI with Azure SQL Database; apply concepts such as language models, prompt engineering, and RAG in data strategies; learn how Microsoft Copilot can streamline development and data workflows with Azure SQL innovations.
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Microsoft Learn MCP Server (setup via VS Code button or mcp.json); Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: Azure SQL Database; Generative AI; Language models; Prompt engineering; Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG); Microsoft Copilot; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; GitHub Copilot; VS Code

Topic: End-to-end BI and analytics solution using Azure Databricks with governance, automated pipelines, AI-powered dashboards, and Power BI integration
Title: LAB531 - Accelerate BI with Azure Databricks in the Era of AI
Title_kr: LAB531 - AI 시대의 Azure Databricks로 BI를 가속화하기
Session_Description: In this 90-minute, beginner-friendly lab, participants build an end-to-end analytics solution using Azure Databricks. The workshop covers automated data pipelines with Lakeflow, enterprise governance with Unity Catalog, and a semantic metric layer with Metric Views. Learners then create AI-powered dashboards using Databricks AI/BI and Genie, integrate with Power BI via DirectQuery, and deploy a full-stack application using Databricks Apps.
Session_Description_kr: 이 90분 분량의 초급자 친화형 실습에서는 Azure Databricks를 사용하여 엔드 투 엔드 분석 솔루션을 구축합니다. Lakeflow를 통한 자동화된 데이터 파이프라인, Unity Catalog를 활용한 엔터프라이즈 거버넌스, Metric Views 기반의 시맨틱 메트릭 레이어를 다룹니다. 이후 Databricks AI/BI 및 Genie로 AI 기반 대시보드를 만들고, DirectQuery로 Power BI와 통합하며, Databricks Apps로 풀스택 애플리케이션을 배포하고 탐색합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Build automated data pipelines using Lakeflow (Spark Declarative Pipelines) with data quality checks and CDC; apply enterprise data governance with Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, row-level security); create semantic metric layers using Metric Views; build AI-powered dashboards with Databricks AI/BI and Genie; integrate Databricks with Power BI using DirectQuery; deploy and explore a full-stack app on Databricks Apps; apply the medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture for analytics data.
Lab_Modules: Introduction; Setup - Import repo, configure, deploy; Lab 01 - Lakeflow Data Transformation; Lab 02 - Unity Catalog Governance; Lab 03 - AI/BI Dashboards & Genie; Lab 04 - Publish to Power BI; Lab 05 - Databricks App Deployment & Exploration; Wrap-Up & Next Steps; Quick Start - Environment Setup (launch workspace, import Git folder, run setup notebook); Deploy Workshop Resources (UI method; CLI method); Run the Workshop Job (Lakeflow orchestration job); Databricks App - Start and Deploy; Lab 01 steps (explore dimension definitions in transformations: dim_customer.py, dim_date.py, dim_employee.py, dim_host.py, dim_property.py; review @dp.materialized_view, @dp.expect, generate_sk).
Technologies_Used: Azure Databricks; Unity Catalog; Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP); Databricks SQL; Metric Views; Databricks AI/BI Dashboards; Genie; Databricks Apps; Microsoft Power BI; DirectQuery; Azure portal; Serverless compute; Web Terminal; GitHub
Prerequisites: Access to the provided lab virtual machine and credentials; browser-based work inside the lab VM (no local installation required); access to an Azure Databricks workspace with Lakeflow Pipelines Editor, new pipeline monitoring, and Web Terminal enabled; ability to sign in to Azure portal and import the public GitHub repository into the Databricks workspace.

Topic: Real-time analytics and Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric for event-driven streaming data, dashboards, and alerts
Title: WRK532: Get Real with Real-Time Intelligence to Transform Data into Action
Title_kr: WRK532: Real-Time Intelligence로 실시간 데이터를 행동으로 전환하기
Session_Description: Harness the power of real-time analytics and digital twins to achieve critical operational tasks. In this lab, you will transform physical systems into dynamic digital replicas to improve simulations and optimize operations. You will build end-to-end solutions for event-driven scenarios using streaming data and data logs. The hands-on exercises help you drive faster decision-making and innovation with real-time insights.
Session_Description_kr: 이 세션에서는 실시간 분석과 디지털 트윈의 역량을 활용하여 핵심 운영 과제를 수행하는 방법을 다룹니다. 본 실습에서 참가자는 물리적 시스템을 동적인 디지털 복제본으로 전환하여 시뮬레이션을 강화하고 운영을 최적화합니다. 또한 스트리밍 데이터와 데이터 로그를 활용해 이벤트 기반 시나리오를 위한 엔드 투 엔드 솔루션을 구축합니다. 실습 중심의 단계들을 통해 실시간 인사이트로 더 빠른 의사결정과 조직의 혁신을 촉진할 수 있습니다.
Learning_Objectives: Set up Microsoft Fabric resources for a real-time event stream using sample bicycle telemetry data. Ingest and query streaming data with KQL, build real-time dashboards, create a Power BI report from KQL outputs, and configure alerts to monitor event stream changes.
Lab_Modules: ['Create and configure a real-time event stream in Microsoft Fabric', 'Ingest and query streaming data using KQL', 'Build a real-time dashboard to visualize data', 'Create a Power BI report from KQL query output', 'Set alerts on event streams to monitor data changes']
Technologies_Used: ['Microsoft Fabric', 'Real-Time Intelligence (Microsoft Fabric)', 'Kusto Query Language (KQL)', 'Fabric Data Agent', 'Power BI']

Topic: Hands-on lab for building scalable, AI-ready data solutions using SQL Database in Microsoft Fabric, including Copilot, RAG with Azure OpenAI, GraphQL APIs, and Power BI reporting.
Title: LAB533: Develop Scalable Data Solutions with SQL Database in Microsoft Fabric
Title_kr: LAB533: Microsoft Fabric의 SQL Database로 확장 가능한 데이터 솔루션 개발
Session_Description: This hands-on lab guides participants through designing, building, and operationalizing scalable data solutions using SQL database in Microsoft Fabric. Attendees will use Copilot-assisted T-SQL and natural language querying, implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Azure OpenAI using vector embeddings and similarity search, and expose capabilities through GraphQL APIs. The lab also covers creating Power BI reports and semantic models from SQL analytics endpoints within the Fabric ecosystem.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩은 Microsoft Fabric의 SQL database를 중심으로 확장 가능한 데이터 솔루션을 설계, 구축, 운영하는 과정을 안내합니다. 참가자는 Copilot을 활용한 T-SQL 개발 및 자연어 쿼리 기능을 사용하고, 벡터 임베딩과 유사도 검색을 기반으로 Azure OpenAI를 활용한 RAG(Retrieval-Augmented Generation)를 구현합니다. 또한 GraphQL API로 기능을 노출하고, Fabric 에코시스템 내 SQL analytics endpoint를 기반으로 Power BI 보고서와 semantic model을 생성하는 방법을 다룹니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Create and configure SQL databases in Microsoft Fabric - Use Copilot for T-SQL development, NL2SQL, query explanation, and error fixing - Implement RAG using vector embeddings and semantic similarity search (VECTOR_DISTANCE) - Build GraphQL APIs backed by stored procedures and AI-powered responses via chat completions - Create Power BI reports using semantic models from SQL analytics endpoints - Understand an end-to-end architecture for AI-ready data solutions in Microsoft Fabric
Lab_Modules: Module 1: Introduction to SQL Database in Fabric (workspace and database setup; load sample data; SQL analytics endpoints and OneLake mirroring; replication monitoring) Module 2: Copilot Capabilities for SQL Database (AI query assistance; NL2SQL; error fixing and explanations; interaction modes) Module 3: RAG Implementation with Azure OpenAI (vector embeddings; semantic similarity search with VECTOR_DISTANCE; stored procedures for recommendations; database scoped credentials) Module 4: GraphQL API for RAG Applications (GraphQL design using vector search; API-optimized stored procedures; chat completion integration; client code generation) Module 5: Power BI Reports Using Semantic Models (semantic models from SQL analytics endpoints; Copilot-assisted report building; geographic sales insights; automated report generation)
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Fabric; SQL database in Microsoft Fabric; T-SQL; SQL analytics endpoints; OneLake; Copilot; Azure OpenAI Service; GPT-4; text-embedding-ada-002; Vector embeddings; VECTOR_DISTANCE; Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); GraphQL; Stored procedures; Power BI; Semantic models; AdventureWorks sample data
Prerequisites: Access to Microsoft Fabric workspace; Azure OpenAI Service deployment (provided in lab environment); Basic understanding of SQL and T-SQL syntax; Familiarity with Microsoft Power BI (helpful but not required)

Topic: Building a real-time analytics solution using Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric, including streaming pipelines, cross-database analytics, Reverse ETL, and personalized recommendations
Title: LAB534: Build Real-Time Analytics with Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric
Title_kr: LAB534: Microsoft Fabric에서 Cosmos DB로 실시간 분석 구축
Session_Description: Learn how to build a complete real-time analytics solution using Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric. This hands-on lab demonstrates how to create an operational data store, implement streaming data pipelines, build cross-database analytics, and deploy personalized recommendations using Reverse ETL patterns.
Session_Description_kr: Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric를 사용하여 완전한 실시간 분석 솔루션을 구축하는 방법을 학습합니다. 이 실습 랩에서는 운영 데이터 저장소를 생성하고, 스트리밍 데이터 파이프라인을 구현하며, 크로스 데이터베이스 분석을 구축하고, Reverse ETL 패턴을 활용해 개인화 추천을 배포하는 과정을 시연합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Provision and configure Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric as an operational data store; implement real-time streaming using Eventstreams and KQL for POS transaction data; build cross-database analytics using Cosmos DB automatic mirroring to OneLake; create data warehouses and perform ETL from streaming to structured data; implement Reverse ETL patterns to update operational systems with analytical insights; deploy personalized recommendation models using machine learning and customer behavior data.
Lab_Modules: Fabric Environment Setup; Exercise 1: Provisioning Cosmos DB in Fabric; Exercise 2: Cross-Database Analytics; Exercise 3: Real-Time Streaming; Exercise 4: Reverse ETL & ML; Exercise 5: Serve Personalized Recommendations from Cosmos DB
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Fabric; Cosmos DB in Microsoft Fabric; Real-Time Intelligence Workload; Eventstreams; KQL; Eventhouse; OneLake; OneLake mirroring; Data Warehouse (Fabric); Fabric Notebooks; Apache Spark (PySpark); .NET 10; C#; SQL Endpoint; REST APIs; JSON
Prerequisites: Access to Microsoft Fabric workspace with appropriate permissions; basic familiarity with SQL, NoSQL databases, and data analytics concepts; understanding of JSON data structures and REST APIs

Topic: Designing and deploying a unified AI and analytics solution across Microsoft using Azure Databricks and related services
Title: LAB535: Azure Databricks in Action: Unified AI & Analytics Across Microsoft
Title_kr: LAB535: Azure Databricks 실전: Microsoft 전반에서 통합 AI 및 분석 구현
Session_Description: In this hands-on lab, participants design and deploy a modern, cloud-native analytics and AI solution using Azure Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Copilot Studio. Using the Zava-Litware scenario, they perform data ingestion, orchestration with Lakeflow, and AI-driven insights via Genie. The lab also covers a mirrored catalog in Microsoft Fabric, low-code automation with Copilot Studio, and advanced reporting in Power BI to demonstrate scalable, cost-efficient AI-powered analytics for business transformation.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Azure Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio를 사용하여 현대적인 클라우드 네이티브 분석 및 AI 솔루션을 설계하고 배포합니다. Zava-Litware 시나리오를 기반으로 데이터 수집, Lakeflow를 통한 오케스트레이션, Genie를 활용한 AI 기반 인사이트 도출을 수행합니다. 또한 Microsoft Fabric의 미러드 카탈로그, Copilot Studio의 로우코드 자동화, Power BI의 고급 리포팅까지 다루며, 비즈니스 혁신을 위한 확장 가능하고 비용 효율적인 AI 기반 분석을 구현합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Design and deploy a cloud-native analytics and AI solution with Azure Databricks; perform data ingestion and orchestration using Lakeflow; generate AI-driven insights using Genie; integrate with Microsoft Fabric via a mirrored catalog; build low-code automation with Microsoft Copilot Studio; create advanced reports in Power BI; understand how to build scalable and cost-efficient AI-powered analytics solutions.
Lab_Modules: Design and deploy modern analytics and AI solution; Data ingestion (Zava-Litware scenario); Orchestration with Lakeflow; AI-driven insights via Genie; Mirrored catalog in Microsoft Fabric; Low-code automation with Microsoft Copilot Studio; Advanced reporting in Power BI
Technologies_Used: Azure Databricks; Azure AI Foundry; Microsoft Copilot Studio; Lakeflow; Genie; Microsoft Fabric; Power BI; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; GitHub Copilot; VS Code

Topic: End-to-end technical lab on Microsoft Fabric to unify data in OneLake, enable governed analytics, and build generative AI solutions with Fabric data agents and Copilot.
Title: PREL14: Unify data, act on insights, and build AI solutions with Microsoft Fabric
Title_kr: PREL14: Microsoft Fabric로 데이터를 통합하고 인사이트에 기반해 실행하며 AI 솔루션을 구축하기
Session_Description: This half-day technical lab provides an end-to-end experience with Microsoft Fabric, starting in OneLake to understand how a single copy of data can streamline governance and reduce duplication. Participants complete guided, role-based labs to ingest, transform, and enrich data, accelerate development with Copilot, and build a conversational Q&A system using Fabric data agents. The session concludes with data visualization in Power BI, resulting in a complete governed data-to-insight workflow.
Session_Description_kr: 이 반일(half-day) 기술 랩에서는 Microsoft Fabric를 엔드 투 엔드로 직접 경험합니다. OneLake에서 시작하여 단일 데이터 사본이 거버넌스를 간소화하고 중복을 제거하는 방식을 살펴봅니다. 참가자는 역할 기반 가이드 랩을 통해 데이터를 수집, 변환, 보강하고 Copilot으로 데이터 솔루션 개발을 가속화하며 Fabric data agents를 사용해 대화형 Q&A 시스템을 구축합니다. 마지막으로 Power BI로 데이터를 시각화하여, 거버넌스가 적용된 완전한 데이터-인사이트 워크플로를 완성합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Understand options for loading and storing data in a Microsoft Fabric analytics solution; perform basic data transformations using Spark and T-SQL; create, configure, and evaluate a Microsoft Fabric data agent.
Lab_Modules: OneLake and single-copy data governance overview; Architecture for a generative AI solution in Fabric; Data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment (multiple methods); Copilot-assisted development for data solutions; Build a conversational Q&A system with Fabric data agents; Visualize data using Power BI
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Fabric (Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Data Science/data agent); OneLake; Spark; T-SQL; Copilot; Power BI; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; VS Code

Topic: Integrating Microsoft Purview with Microsoft Defender XDR to investigate insider risk and security incidents
Title: Lab540: Microsoft Purview Integration with Microsoft Defender XDR
Title_kr: Lab540: Microsoft Purview와 Microsoft Defender XDR 통합
Session_Description: As threats grow more complex, teams need improved visibility and context to defend threats faster. In this lab, participants explore how Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender XDR integrate to help organizations investigate security incidents through a single pane. The session covers sharing and investigating insider risk alerts, incident investigation workflows, and threat hunting using KQL and Advanced Hunting. Learners also retrieve insider risk alert data via Microsoft Graph API and interpret Data Security Investigation results.
Session_Description_kr: 위협이 점점 더 복잡해짐에 따라, 팀은 더 빠르게 위협에 대응하기 위해 향상된 가시성과 컨텍스트가 필요합니다. 이 랩에서는 Microsoft Purview와 Microsoft Defender XDR이 통합되어 단일 화면에서 보안 인시던트를 조사할 수 있도록 조직을 지원하는 방법을 살펴봅니다. 또한 Insider Risk 알림 공유 및 조사, 인시던트 조사 워크플로, KQL 및 Advanced Hunting을 활용한 위협 헌팅을 다룹니다. 아울러 Microsoft Graph API를 통해 Insider Risk 알림 데이터를 가져오고 Data Security Investigation 결과를 실행 및 해석합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Share insider risk alerts with Microsoft Defender XDR; investigate insider risk alerts and incidents in Microsoft Defender XDR; run KQL queries for threat hunting in Advanced Hunting; retrieve insider risk alert data via Microsoft Graph API; run and interpret Data Security Investigation results.
Lab_Modules: Share insider risk alerts with Microsoft Defender XDR; Investigate insider risk alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR; Investigate incidents in Microsoft Defender XDR; Run KQL queries in Advanced Hunting; Pull insider risk alert data via Microsoft Graph API; Run and interpret a Data Security Investigation
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management; Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations; Microsoft Defender XDR; Microsoft Graph APIs; KQL; Advanced Hunting

Topic: Defending against threats using Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint in a Security Operations (SecOps) scenario
Title: LAB541: Defend against threats with Microsoft Defender XDR
Title_kr: LAB541: Microsoft Defender XDR로 위협으로부터 방어하기
Session_Description: In this lab, you act as a Security Operations Analyst at a company implementing Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. You will onboard a small set of devices to validate configuration and understand required changes to SecOps response procedures. The session includes running a simulated attack and using Defender XDR to investigate resulting alerts and incidents.
Session_Description_kr: 이 랩에서는 Microsoft Defender XDR 및 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint를 도입하는 회사의 보안 운영 분석가 역할을 수행합니다. 소수의 디바이스를 온보딩하여 구성을 검증하고 SecOps 대응 절차에 필요한 변경 사항을 파악합니다. 또한 모의 공격을 수행하고 Defender XDR을 사용하여 생성된 경고와 인시던트를 조사합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Deploy and configure Microsoft Defender XDR; deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and onboard devices; run a simulated attack and investigate alerts and incidents using Microsoft Defender XDR.
Lab_Modules: Deploy and configure Microsoft Defender XDR; Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and onboard devices; Simulate an attack; Investigate alerts and incidents in Microsoft Defender XDR.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Defender XDR; Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Topic: Zero Trust security for identities and devices using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID
Title: Zero Trust Lab: Securing Identities and Devices with Intune and Entra
Title_kr: Zero Trust 랩: Intune 및 Entra를 사용하여 ID와 디바이스를 보호하기
Session_Description: This repository contains the complete content for the hands-on lab "Zero Trust Lab: Securing Identities and Devices with Intune and Entra." Participants gain practical experience implementing Zero Trust security principles using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID to secure identities and devices in modern enterprise environments. The lab covers configuring compliance and conditional access, identity protection, device enrollment, security baselines, and threat monitoring/response.
Session_Description_kr: 이 리포지토리는 "Zero Trust 랩: Intune 및 Entra를 사용하여 ID와 디바이스를 보호하기" 실습 랩의 전체 콘텐츠를 포함합니다. 참가자는 Microsoft Intune과 Microsoft Entra ID를 사용하여 현대적인 엔터프라이즈 환경에서 ID와 디바이스를 보호하는 Zero Trust 보안 원칙을 구현하는 실무 경험을 얻습니다. 또한 규정 준수 및 조건부 액세스 구성, ID 보호, 디바이스 등록, 보안 기준선, 위협 모니터링 및 대응을 다룹니다.
Learning_Objectives: Implement Zero Trust security principles using Microsoft Intune and Entra ID; configure device compliance policies and conditional access rules; set up identity protection and risk-based authentication; manage device enrollment and security baselines; monitor and respond to security threats in a Zero Trust environment.
Lab_Modules: Implement Zero Trust security principles with Intune and Entra ID; Configure device compliance policies; Configure conditional access rules; Set up identity protection; Configure risk-based authentication; Manage device enrollment; Apply security baselines; Monitor and respond to security threats.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Intune; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory); Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; Azure Security Center; PowerShell

Topic: Threat hunting and log analysis in Microsoft Sentinel using Kusto Query Language (KQL) and Sentinel Data Lake
Title: LAB543: Perform threat hunting in Microsoft Sentinel
Title_kr: LAB543: Microsoft Sentinel에서 위협 헌팅 수행
Session_Description: In this lab, you act as a Security Operations Analyst at a company implementing Microsoft Sentinel. You will analyze log data to search for malicious activity, build visualizations, and perform threat hunting. You will use Kusto Query Language (KQL) to query and investigate data, including working with Sentinel Data Lake and advanced hunting capabilities.
Session_Description_kr: 이 랩에서는 Microsoft Sentinel을 도입하는 회사의 Security Operations Analyst 역할을 수행합니다. 로그 데이터를 분석하여 악성 활동을 탐지하고, 시각화를 구성하며, 위협 헌팅을 수행합니다. Sentinel Data Lake 및 고급 헌팅 기능을 포함하여 Kusto Query Language(KQL)를 사용해 데이터를 쿼리하고 조사합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Ingest and analyze data in Sentinel Data Lake using KQL; hunt for threats using Microsoft Sentinel Advanced Hunting; hunt for threats using Data lake graph; create a Microsoft Sentinel Hunt and Livestream; hunt for threats using MITRE ATT&CK; use Data lake KQL jobs.
Lab_Modules: Ingest and analyze data in Sentinel Data Lake with KQL; Threat hunting with Microsoft Sentinel Advanced Hunting; Threat hunting with Data lake graph; Create a Microsoft Sentinel Hunt and Livestream; Threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK; Use Data lake KQL jobs.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Sentinel; Microsoft Defender XDR; Sentinel Data Lake; Kusto Query Language (KQL)

Topic: Zero Trust security across data, infrastructure, network, and security operations using Microsoft security tools
Title: LAB546: Securing the Stack – Zero Trust for Data, Infra, Network & SOC
Title_kr: LAB546: 스택 보안 강화 – 데이터, 인프라, 네트워크 및 SOC를 위한 Zero Trust
Session_Description: This hands-on lab introduces participants to the Microsoft Zero Trust Workshop and walks through securing the technology stack across four pillars: Data, Infrastructure, Network, and Security Operations. Participants explore the workshop tool and delivery guide, then run demos and scenarios to apply Zero Trust principles in an enterprise context. The lab uses Microsoft security products to simulate real-world situations and helps learners assess implementation effort and user impact using the Zero Trust roadmap.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Microsoft Zero Trust Workshop을 소개하고 데이터, 인프라, 네트워크, 보안 운영의 네 가지 핵심 축에 걸쳐 기술 스택을 보호하는 방법을 안내합니다. 참가자는 워크숍 도구와 제공 가이드를 살펴본 뒤, 데모와 시나리오를 수행하며 엔터프라이즈 환경에서 Zero Trust 원칙을 적용합니다. 또한 Microsoft 보안 제품을 활용해 실제 상황을 모사하고, Zero Trust 로드맵을 통해 구현 노력과 사용자 영향을 평가합니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Understand the Data, Infrastructure, and Network pillars of the Microsoft Zero Trust Workshop - Explore the Zero Trust workshop tool and delivery guide - Apply Zero Trust principles to data protection, network access, and SOC operations - Use Microsoft Purview, Entra, Sentinel, and Defender to simulate real-world scenarios - Evaluate implementation effort and user impact using the Zero Trust roadmap
Lab_Modules: 1. Introduction to Zero Trust Workshop (access workshop homepage; review pillars and delivery guide) 2. Data Pillar (Sensitive Data Discovery with Microsoft Purview; Insider Risk Management demo; Conditional Access policy walkthrough for Insider Risk) 3. Network Pillar (Global Secure Access client deployment; traffic forwarding and DLP integration; monitoring application segments and client download options) 4. Security Operations Pillar (review a simulated attack; proactive avoidance with Microsoft Security Exposure Management and Sentinel data lake)
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview; Microsoft Entra (Global Secure Access); Microsoft Sentinel; Microsoft Defender Exposure Management; Security Copilot; Conditional Access; Sentinel data lake
Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Microsoft security tools; Access to lab environment with provided credentials; Excel and browser access within the VM

Topic: Strengthening identity security posture using Conditional Access aligned to Zero Trust in Microsoft Entra ID, including safe rollout and optimization with the Conditional Access Optimization Agent (Security Copilot).
Title: LAB549: Strengthen your identity security posture with Conditional Access
Title_kr: LAB549: Conditional Access로 ID 보안 태세를 강화하기
Session_Description: Secure your tenant with Conditional Access aligned to Zero Trust. In this hands-on lab, you will learn safe rollout patterns and use the CA Optimization Agent–Security Copilot in Entra to scan daily, flag gaps, and remediate with one-click and phased enforcement.
Session_Description_kr: Zero Trust에 맞춰 Conditional Access로 테넌트를 보호합니다. 이 실습형 랩에서는 안전한 롤아웃 패턴을 학습하고, Entra의 CA Optimization Agent–Security Copilot을 사용하여 매일 스캔하고 격차를 표시하며, 원클릭 및 단계적 적용으로 개선 조치를 수행하는 방법을 다룹니다.
Learning_Objectives: Create a basic Conditional Access policy; verify policy reach using the WhatIf Analysis tool; block access to cloud resources using Conditional Access; configure and use the Conditional Access Optimization Agent.
Lab_Modules: Create a basic Conditional Access policy; Use WhatIf Analysis to verify policy reach; Block access to cloud resources with Conditional Access; Configure and use the Conditional Access Optimization Agent.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Entra ID; Microsoft Entra Conditional Access; Conditional Access Optimization Agent (Security Copilot in Entra); WhatIf Analysis tool

Topic: Identity governance at scale with Microsoft Entra
Title: Lab544: Govern identities with confidence using Microsoft Entra
Title_kr: Lab544: Microsoft Entra를 사용하여 신뢰할 수 있게 ID를 거버넌스하기
Session_Description: Gain the skills to govern identities at scale with Microsoft Entra. Get hands-on experience automating provisioning, streamlining access, enforcing governance policies, and configuring Face Check for identity validation to reduce risk and ensure compliance.
Session_Description_kr: Microsoft Entra를 사용하여 대규모로 ID를 거버넌스하는 역량을 습득합니다. 프로비저닝 자동화, 액세스 간소화, 거버넌스 정책 적용, 그리고 위험을 줄이고 규정 준수를 보장하기 위한 ID 검증용 Face Check 구성에 대한 실습 경험을 제공합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Configure and deploy a Lifecyle Workflow; Create an Entitlement package and use it to grant user access; Design an Access Review and run it; Use Just-in-Time access with Privileged Identity Management
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Learning Outcomes; Technologies Used; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Entra Lifecycle Workflows; Microsoft Entra Entitlement Management; Privileged Identity Management; Access Reviews; Face Check; Microsoft Learn MCP Server; GitHub Copilot; VS Code

Topic: Mitigating cloud threats and improving cloud security posture using Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Title: LAB550: Mitigating cloud threats with Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Title_kr: LAB550: Microsoft Defender for Cloud를 사용하여 클라우드 위협을 완화하기
Session_Description: Attendees will learn to enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud, navigate its dashboard, and interpret regulatory compliance and workload protection insights. The labs cover secure score analysis, security recommendations, inventory management, pricing models, and governance rule assignment. By the end, participants will be equipped to proactively identify and mitigate threats, strengthen cloud security posture, and align with organizational governance standards.
Session_Description_kr: 참가자는 Microsoft Defender for Cloud를 활성화하고 대시보드를 탐색하며 규정 준수 및 워크로드 보호 인사이트를 해석하는 방법을 학습합니다. 실습에서는 Secure Score 분석, 보안 권장 사항, 인벤토리 관리, 가격 책정 모델, 거버넌스 규칙 할당을 다룹니다. 과정이 끝나면 참가자는 위협을 선제적으로 식별하고 완화하며 클라우드 보안 태세를 강화하고 조직의 거버넌스 표준에 맞출 수 있게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud; configure its primary features; use the Defender for Cloud dashboard to quickly explore and update security posture; use recommendations from Defender for Cloud to mitigate threats.
Lab_Modules: Enable Defender for Cloud; Dashboard navigation and security posture review; Regulatory compliance and workload protection insights; Secure score analysis; Security recommendations; Inventory management; Pricing models; Governance rule assignment.
