Technologies_Used: Microsoft Defender for Cloud; Microsoft Azure

Topic: Hands-on lab for maximizing cloud security posture management (CSPM) using Microsoft Defender for Cloud across hybrid environments
Title: LAB551: Maximizing Cloud Security: CSPM in Microsoft Defender Cloud
Title_kr: LAB551: 클라우드 보안 극대화: Microsoft Defender for Cloud의 CSPM
Session_Description: This lab provides a hands-on deep dive into Microsoft Defender for Cloud’s CSPM capabilities to assess and improve cloud security across hybrid environments. Participants will identify misconfigurations, apply compliance frameworks, and automate remediation strategies to strengthen their overall security posture.
Session_Description_kr: 이 랩은 Microsoft Defender for Cloud의 CSPM 기능을 실습 중심으로 심층적으로 다루며, 하이브리드 환경 전반에서 클라우드 보안을 평가하고 개선하는 방법을 학습합니다. 참가자는 구성 오류를 식별하고, 규정 준수 프레임워크를 적용하며, 자동화된 수정(리미디에이션) 전략을 적용하여 전반적인 보안 태세를 강화합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud CSPM; Review potential attack paths using Attack Path Analysis; Use Query Builder to identify resources that might be at risk
Lab_Modules: Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud CSPM; Attack Path Analysis to review potential attack paths; Query Builder to find at-risk resources
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Defender for Cloud; Microsoft Azure

Topic: Create and manage sensitive information types and sensitivity labels using Microsoft Purview Information Protection and DLP to protect data from AI tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot
Title: LAB545: Create and Manage sensitive information types and labels
Title_kr: LAB545: 중요한 정보 유형 및 레이블 생성 및 관리
Session_Description: As organizations adopt AI tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot, protecting sensitive data is essential. In this hands-on session, you'll use Microsoft Purview Information Protection and DLP to classify and secure project data. You'll create custom sensitive information types, publish sensitivity labels, and add a DLP policy that prevents Copilot from processing protected content.
Session_Description_kr: 조직이 Microsoft 365 Copilot과 같은 AI 도구를 도입함에 따라 중요한 데이터를 보호하는 것이 필수적입니다. 이 실습 세션에서는 Microsoft Purview Information Protection 및 DLP를 사용하여 프로젝트 데이터를 분류하고 보호합니다. 사용자 지정 중요한 정보 유형을 만들고, 민감도 레이블을 게시하며, Copilot이 보호된 콘텐츠를 처리하지 못하도록 하는 DLP 정책을 추가합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Create and test custom sensitive information types in Microsoft Purview; Build and publish sensitivity labels to classify project data; Configure auto-apply labeling to protect sensitive content automatically; Create a DLP policy that prevents Copilot from processing protected content
Lab_Modules: Enable auditing in Microsoft Purview; Create and test a custom sensitive information type; Build a parent and sublabel structure for project data; Publish sensitivity labels for manual and auto-apply use; Configure an auto-apply policy to label project data automatically; (Optional) Create a DLP policy that prevents Copilot from processing protected content
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview Information Protection; Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP); Microsoft Purview Audit; Microsoft 365 Copilot

Topic: Implementing insider risk management and adaptive protection for risky AI activity using Microsoft Purview
Title: LAB547: Implement Insider Risk Management and Adaptive Protection
Title_kr: LAB547: Insider Risk Management 및 Adaptive Protection 구현
Session_Description: AI tools like Microsoft Copilot improve productivity but can also expose sensitive data. In this session, you'll use Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management to detect and respond to risky AI activity. You'll enable analytics, create policies that use AI and DLP signals, and turn on Adaptive Protection to automatically adjust enforcement as risk levels change.
Session_Description_kr: Microsoft Copilot과 같은 AI 도구는 생산성을 높이지만 민감한 데이터가 노출될 위험도 있습니다. 이 세션에서는 Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management를 사용하여 위험한 AI 활동을 탐지하고 대응합니다. 분석을 활성화하고 AI 및 DLP 신호를 활용하는 정책을 생성하며, 위험 수준 변화에 따라 적용을 자동으로 조정하도록 Adaptive Protection을 설정합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Enable and configure Insider Risk Management analytics and indicators for AI-related activity; Create and customize Risky AI usage policies and notice templates; Integrate Insider Risk Management with DLP and Adaptive Protection to automatically respond to risky AI prompts and responses
Lab_Modules: Enable analytics and configure insider risk indicators; Create a Risky AI usage policy; Add notice templates and assign insider risk levels; Connect Insider Risk Management with DLP and Adaptive Protection
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management; Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP); Microsoft Copilot

Topic: Preventing sensitive data exposure in Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI apps using Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Adaptive Protection
Title: LAB548: Prevent data exposure in Copilot and AI apps with data loss prevention
Title_kr: LAB548: 데이터 손실 방지를 통해 Copilot 및 AI 앱에서 데이터 노출을 방지하기
Session_Description: AI tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot can boost productivity but may also expose sensitive information. In this lab, you use Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect data across Copilot and AI environments by creating and testing DLP policies. You also configure endpoint protections to block uploads and pastes to AI websites and enable Adaptive Protection to dynamically adjust safeguards when user risk increases.
Session_Description_kr: Microsoft 365 Copilot과 같은 AI 도구는 생산성을 높이지만 민감한 정보가 노출될 위험도 있습니다. 이 랩에서는 Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention(DLP)을 사용하여 Copilot 및 AI 환경 전반에서 데이터를 보호하기 위해 DLP 정책을 생성하고 테스트합니다. 또한 AI 웹사이트로의 업로드 및 붙여넣기를 차단하도록 엔드포인트 보호를 구성하고, 사용자 위험이 증가할 때 보호 조치를 동적으로 조정하도록 Adaptive Protection을 활성화합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Create and test DLP policies that prevent Copilot from processing sensitive data; configure endpoint DLP to block uploads and pastes to AI websites; enable Adaptive Protection to adjust enforcement based on user risk.
Lab_Modules: Create a DLP policy to keep sensitive data out of Microsoft 365 Copilot; Test the policy in simulation and activate it; Configure an endpoint DLP policy to block uploads or pastes to AI websites; (Optional) Use Adaptive Protection to apply safeguards based on user risk.
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP); Microsoft Purview Adaptive Protection; Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management; Microsoft 365 Copilot

Topic: Hands-on security hardening for a Microsoft 365 tenant to become Copilot/AI-ready using baselines and data labeling
Title: PREL18: Copilot Ready: Strategy, Data, and Security
Title_kr: PREL18: Copilot Ready: 전략, 데이터 및 보안
Session_Description: This session provides a hands-on approach to improving the security of a Microsoft 365 tenant. It walks participants through identifying insecure defaults, applying security baselines, and using data labeling strategies to support Copilot and AI adoption. By the end, attendees will be able to build a hardened, AI-ready tenant and feel confident maintaining it over time.
Session_Description_kr: 이 세션은 Microsoft 365 테넌트의 보안을 개선하기 위한 실습 중심의 접근 방식을 제공합니다. Copilot 및 AI 도입을 지원하기 위해 안전하지 않은 기본 설정을 식별하고, 보안 기준선을 적용하며, 데이터 레이블링 전략을 활용하는 과정을 안내합니다. 세션을 마치면 강화된 AI 준비 테넌트를 구축하고, 이를 지속적으로 유지·관리할 수 있는 자신감을 갖추게 됩니다.
Learning_Objectives: Identify insecure default configurations in a Microsoft 365 tenant; apply security baselines to harden the environment; implement data labeling strategies to support secure Copilot/AI usage; understand how to maintain an AI-ready, hardened tenant over time.
Lab_Modules: Identifying insecure defaults; Applying security baselines; Data labeling strategies; Building and maintaining a hardened, AI-ready tenant
Technologies_Used: Microsoft Purview; Microsoft Copilot; SAM; DSPM for AI; Microsoft 365

Topic: Building declarative Copilot agents using TypeSpec and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit
Title: LAB560 - Building Declarative Agents with TypeSpec and M365 Agents Toolkit
Title_kr: LAB560 - TypeSpec 및 M365 Agents Toolkit을 사용하여 Declarative Agent 구축

Session_Description_kr: 이 실습에서는 이제 정식 출시된 Windows ML을 사용하여 더 똑똑한 이미지 분류 앱을 구축합니다. NPU용 Execution Provider(EP)를 동적으로 다운로드하고, 하드웨어별 EP에 맞게 모델을 컴파일한 뒤, 로컬에서 추론을 실행하는 과정을 단계별로 다룹니다. 또한 WinML API를 사용해 앱을 배포, 디버그, 최적화하는 방법을 학습합니다. 사전 배포된 EP 없이 Windows 디바이스에서 AI 가속을 탐색하는 개발자에게 적합합니다.
Learning_Objectives: - Build an app which dynamically registers Execution Providers and uses shared ONNX Runtime - Acquire and register execution providers using the Windows ML APIs - Compile, load, and run an ONNX model (SqueezeNet) with hardware acceleration
Technologies_Used: Windows ML;ONNX Runtime;Windows App SDK;ONNX;NPU;WinML APIs;SqueezeNet

Topic: Adding local AI capabilities to a Windows WPF application using Windows AI APIs (Semantic Search, OCR, and Phi-Silica) to query PDF documents with RAG-style experiences.
Title: LAB585: Supercharge your apps with local AI
Title_kr: LAB585: 로컬 AI로 앱을 강화하기
Session_Description: In this lab, you will learn how to add new AI features into a WPF app by building an application that queries a PDF file and returns answers based on its contents. You will use Semantic Search for indexing and retrieval, OCR for text extraction, and the local Phi-Silica language model to generate responses. The experience includes natural-language querying, visual page previews, and streaming responses with cancellation support.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습에서는 WPF 앱에 새로운 AI 기능을 추가하여 PDF 파일을 질의하고 그 내용에 기반한 답변을 반환하는 애플리케이션을 구축하는 방법을 학습합니다. Semantic Search를 사용해 인덱싱 및 검색을 수행하고, OCR로 텍스트를 추출하며, 로컬 Phi-Silica 언어 모델로 응답을 생성합니다. 자연어 질의, 관련 페이지의 시각적 미리보기, 취소를 지원하는 스트리밍 응답까지 포함한 경험을 구현합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Build an AI-enhanced Windows application with modern UI; implement semantic indexing and semantic search over app content; perform local RAG-style querying by combining Semantic Search with Phi-Silica; enable natural-language Q&A over PDF documents; extract text from PDF pages using the OCR API and render/preview relevant pages; implement streaming AI responses with cancellation support.
Lab_Modules: Session Description; Learning Outcomes; Technologies Used; Semantic Search; OCR; Phi-Silica; Resources and Next Steps
Technologies_Used: WPF; .NET 9.0; Windows 11; Windows App SDK (WinAppSDK); Fluent UI / WinUI 3; Windows AI APIs (App Content Search / Semantic Search); OCR AI API (Text Recognition); Phi-Silica local language model; Windows AI Foundry

Topic: Windows 365 AI lab for enabling and experiencing Semantic Search, Federated Search, and Click2Do on Cloud PCs, plus integrating Windows 365 for Agents with Copilot Studio
Title: LAB587: Windows 365 AI Lab: Semantic, Federated Search and Click2Do in Action
Title_kr: LAB587: Windows 365 AI 랩: 시맨틱 검색, 페더레이티드 검색 및 Click2Do 실습
Session_Description: In this hands-on lab, participants configure and experience Windows 365 AI features including Semantic Search, Federated Search, and Click2Do. You will learn how to enable these capabilities on Cloud PCs, understand prerequisites, and see how they improve IT admin workflows and end-user productivity. The lab also explores integrating Windows 365 for Agents with Copilot Studio to identify automation opportunities and to design and publish a custom Copilot experience that interacts with Windows 365.
Session_Description_kr: 이 실습형 랩에서는 Windows 365 AI의 시맨틱 검색, 페더레이티드 검색, Click2Do 기능을 구성하고 직접 체험합니다. Cloud PC에서 이러한 기능을 활성화하는 방법과 사전 요구 사항을 이해하고, IT 관리자 워크플로우와 최종 사용자 생산성을 어떻게 향상시키는지 살펴봅니다. 또한 Windows 365 for Agents와 Copilot Studio의 통합을 분석하여 AI 기반 자동화 기회를 도출하고, Windows 365와 상호작용하는 맞춤형 Copilot 경험을 설계 및 게시합니다.
Learning_Objectives: Enable and validate Semantic Search, Federated Search, and Click2Do on Windows 365 Cloud PCs; understand prerequisites for AI-enabled Cloud PCs and related configuration requirements; evaluate how these features impact IT administration and end-user experiences; analyze Windows 365 for Agents integration with Copilot Studio; design and publish a custom Copilot experience that interacts with Windows 365.
Lab_Modules: Configure Semantic Search on Windows 365 Cloud PCs; Configure Federated Search on Windows 365 Cloud PCs; Configure and use Click2Do; Review prerequisites for AI-enabled Cloud PCs; Analyze Windows 365 for Agents integration with Copilot Studio; Design and publish a custom Copilot experience for Windows 365
Technologies_Used: Windows 365 Enterprise; Intune; Windows App; Windows 365 for Agents; Copilot Studio
Prerequisites: Understanding of Windows 365 Cloud PCs and administration; Access to Windows 365 Enterprise environment; Intune access for device/cloud PC management; Windows App installed/available for connecting to Cloud PCs
